method: Actual sequential bilingual reading; mechanical checks do not substitute for prose review.

checks.summary: Read introduction, §1.1–1.11 including statements, all proofs, formulas and editor footnotes. Checked reductive/reduced, rank conventions, centralizers, radicals, equivalence directions and external citations. No confirmed translation correction in this interval.

Read Proposition1.12 and Corollary1.13, all proof steps and editor footnotes; §2.1–2.5.0 and Theorem2.5 statement. Checked geometric integrality/reducedness, flatness and finite-presentation conditions, quantifiers, split/trivialized distinction; inherited §2.2 reference to2.4 and II4.11 local-key mismatch preserved.

Read full Theorem2.5 proof, §2.6–2.9, definitions and proofs §3.1–3.7 including functor-of-roots descent and every footnote. Checked open neighborhoods, étale localization, weights and finite rank, root-system quantifiers and empty scheme convention. No confirmed Chinese mistranslation.

Read §3.8–3.10 and §4.1–4.11 through power map W(L)→W(L^q). Checked the full expanded Lemma4.2 footnote and native commutative diagram, uniqueness, module/functor distinction, normalized morphisms and root criterion. Source3.8 omits reductive hypothesis; translation faithful, no silent amendment. Inherited II4.4.2 link targets local scholium4.4.2; preserved.

Read complete Proposition4.12(a)–(c), polynomial proof and Lemma4.13; §5.1–5.7 statements and Lemmas5.3,5.6 proofs, all relation indices and signs/editor notes. No confirmed mistranslation. Known Lemma4.13 difference=1 source issue retained, mathematical truth not certified.

Read Lemma5.7 proof through §6.3 proof and all four bibliography entries. Checked matrices, smoothness and connected-component arguments, affine-open construction5.13 and existing marked French-verified t≠0 correction, torsion centralizers and Hensel lifts, finite/étale Weyl group qualifications. No additional confirmed Chinese mistranslation. Original names, bibliography, native diagram and formulas preserved.

findings.detail: Bible/Ch05 references to theorems and lemmas inherit local XIX keys (e.g. sga3:xix:lemma:1:4 for Bible theorem4; introductory XXIII Corollary5.1 links XIX paragraph5-1). Preserve keys; candidate introductory target is XXIII Corollary5.1 if actual target exists; external Bible references cannot be authenticated by local destinations.
